name: Amanpulo
positioning: Private island resort on Pamalican Island in the Cuyo Archipelago, Palawan, with casitas and villas, reached by a 90-minute flight
best_for: Travelers who want diving and snorkelling from a private island base
Guests who want to spend time on the water by boat

facts.text: Amanpulo is on Pamalican Island in the Cuyo Archipelago, Palawan, Philippines.
The resort's getting-here page lists Clark International Airport as the airport.
The resort's getting-here page lists a 90-minute flight as the transfer.
The accommodation is casitas on the beachfront, in the treetops and on the hillside.
Amanpulo offers villas of up to three bedrooms.
The accommodation page lists daily afternoon tea at the Clubhouse.
The wellness facilities include a Pilates studio with reformers.
The wellness facilities include a yoga and meditation pavilion.
The waters around Pamalican Island have been a self-declared marine sanctuary for over 30 years.
Amanpulo has a PADI Dive Centre that offers guided dive tours and SCUBA diving courses.
The Kawayan Bar is a bamboo platform raft floating a few metres from the shore, for lounging, snorkelling and private celebrations.
The Private Sala is an open-air sala in a corner of the Clubhouse that looks out over the island's gardens and pool.

highlights.text: The Kawayan Bar is a bamboo platform raft floating a few metres from the shore, for lounging, snorkelling and private celebrations.
The waters around Pamalican Island have been a self-declared marine sanctuary for over 30 years.
Amanpulo has a PADI Dive Centre that offers guided dive tours and SCUBA diving courses.
Amanpulo has its own fleet of boats for sunset cruises, fishing expeditions and sailing lessons.

considerations.text: The resort's getting-here page lists a 90-minute flight as the transfer, so reaching the island takes a flight.
The daily morning snorkelling trip from the beach is provided on a first come, first serve basis.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing that reflects the exclusive positioning.
